body.segment: A thiazolothiazole–thiophene copolymer is examined as the active material in bulk heterojunction (BHJ) solar cells.
By optimizing the molecular weight, the polymer-based cells exhibit power conversion efficiencies as high as 5.7%.

The increase in molecular weight improves the orientational order, and blending with phenyl-C61-butyric acid methyl ester (PC61BM) changes the orientational motif from edge-on to face-on, which accounts for the trend in photovoltaic performances.
These results might give new insight into the structure–property relationships in BHJ solar cells.
